topics.motion: An AI system that reliably reduces suffering should be deployed even where the people it decides about cannot be told why.
A self-driving car should be programmed to minimise total deaths in an unavoidable crash, even when that means sacrificing its own passenger.
It is a mistake to say that a language model decides anything.
Training a model on human feedback can make it good in the same sense that moral upbringing makes a person good.
When an AI system causes harm, the people who built it are to blame in proportion to the harm, however careful they were.
Handing daily choices to an AI assistant costs something that matters, even when its choices are better than the ones it replaces.

prerequisites: Migration 0021_sample_activity applied to the target (checked before any write).
The code that reads is_sample deployed (labels, table note, par-window filter in /api/judge, challenge guard).
debate_topics on the target matches the plan's six motions (checked before any write).
.env.seed.production holds SEED_SUPABASE_URL and SEED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY for this project, on the machine that runs the command, with network access to the project.
Auth settings checked: no auth hook or custom SMTP that would act on admin-created users.
No other seed run holds a lock (checked before any write).

effects.writesOutside: None. debate_topics, ai_calls, reports, blocks, payments and analytics are not written. No email is sent; no event is emitted.

runtime.basis: assumed: 150 rows/s and 4 auth users/s until a canary measures them

costs.note: No model call is made: verdicts are templates. On Supabase's free plan the run adds database rows and auth users within the plan's limits; nothing is billed.

validation: Every registry item for the run is created, and every row reads back marked and owned.
Sample rows per table equal the registry's created items across runs.
Spot checks: 50 rows per kind read back equal to the plan's rows.
No sample debate is waiting for a counterpart (seeking_counterpart_at is null).
Genuine rows not removed; genuine profiles' ratings, streaks and schools unchanged; debate_topics par unchanged; elo_percentile(1200) unchanged.
Auth spot check: 20 sample users are banned, carry this run's id, and have the planned email.
recovery: Cancel with Ctrl-C: the current batch finishes, the lock is released, and the same command resumes.
A failed run is resumed by the same command; nothing is written twice.

Teardown removes exactly this run's rows: npm run unseed:production -- --expected-project-ref tekifezydjlgxgndkxul --confirm-production tekifezydjlgxgndkxul --run-id sample-20261104-202611040204 --plan docs/seed-plans/sample-20261104-202611040204.json (preview), then add --execute --confirm-teardown sample-20261104-202611040204.
Teardown clears any genuine reference to a sample row first, and stops if a genuine row could only be kept by deleting it.
Rolling back migration 0021 is possible only after teardown (supabase/rollback/0021_sample_activity.down.sql refuses while sample rows remain).
